title: h1-verify/v1
description: One skeptic's disposition of one finding produced by another model. H1.1 asks whether a different-vendor verifier rejects false RISKY calls without losing real ones, so the disposition is the measurement and the evidence is what makes it checkable.

finding_id.description: The finding under review, copied verbatim from the prompt. It is checked against the finding actually sent, so a verdict cannot be attributed to a different finding.

disposition.description: CONFIRMED: the described defect is real and reachable as stated. REJECTED: it is not - the mechanism does not hold, the code does not do what the finding says, or the condition cannot occur. INCONCLUSIVE: the repository does not settle it either way. INCONCLUSIVE is an honest answer and is counted as not confirmed, never as a rejection.

mechanism_restated.description: The defect as the verifier understands it, in its own words. A restatement that does not match the finding is itself evidence the verifier judged something else.

evidence.description: Repository citations the disposition rests on. Required in practice for REJECTED and CONFIRMED: an unevidenced rejection is an opinion, and the whole point is to test whether a skeptic can do better than one.

lines.description: A line or range, e.g. "417" or "417-428".

reason.description: Why the disposition follows from the evidence. Not a summary of the finding.
